item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena's torch stops working. She opens it and looks at the small incandescent lamp inside. Under which condition can the lamp glow again when the torch is switched on?

options.A: The filament inside the glass bulb is unbroken and joined to both terminals of the cell.
options.B: The glass bulb of the lamp looks whole from the outside, even if the filament is broken.
options.C: The filament is broken, but the lamp is tightly fixed in its holder.
options.D: The lamp is new, but its filament is fused and does not carry current.
